SELECT EVENT_ID AS eventId, COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, EVENT_TITLE AS eventTitle, MAX_PARTICIPANTS AS maxParticipants, CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS AS currentParticipants, ROUND((CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS / MAX_PARTICIPANTS) * 100, 2) AS participationRate, 0 AS participated FROM CL_EVENT WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
